title: Stabilize Version 7 go-live by fixing frontend build/runtime blockers and safe routing redirects

requirements.summary: Resolve frontend compile/build/runtime-blocking issues discovered during a clean rebuild with minimal stability-focused changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend canister builds successfully (Motoko compilation completes with no errors).
Frontend builds successfully (TypeScript + bundler build completes with no errors).
App can start and render the root route (/) and login route (/login) without runtime exceptions in the console.
A new draft can be generated and the publish/go-live step completes successfully without deployment errors.

file_operations.description: Align the generated/declared backendInterface type with the actor usage in the frontend so TypeScript builds cleanly (e.g., include the access-control initialization function that the actor wrapper invokes).

Stabilize app startup rendering by removing any browser-global assumptions and ensuring initial-route rendering/redirect logic cannot throw at first load (keep changes minimal and focused on build/runtime stability). Also ensure admin auto-redirect remains effect-driven. Use the selected "authorization" component patterns for role-based gating behavior where applicable; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure the /login route renders safely in all auth states and that post-login redirection remains stable and non-blocking (no render-time navigation, no loops), supporting clean first load and production builds. Use the selected "authorization" component patterns for authenticated redirects/role checks where applicable; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Audit and fix routing/guard/redirect logic to prevent any navigate/redirect during render and handle redirects in effects or router-safe lifecycle hooks.
acceptanceCriteria: No route performs navigate()/redirect imperatively during the render path (only in effects or router lifecycle hooks).
Visiting /login while already authenticated redirects without triggering React warnings/errors about updates during render.
Visiting /admin as a non-admin shows the Access Denied screen without errors.

file_operations.description: Refactor guard/wrapper logic to ensure navigation decisions (including admin auto-redirect) are derived from router state and executed only within effects (or router lifecycle hooks), never during render, and cannot cause redirect loops. Use the selected "authorization" component guidance for AccessDenied behavior and role-based gating; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Harden authenticated-user redirect handling so that /login redirects are performed only in effects once role state is ready, using safe replace-style navigation and avoiding any state updates during render. Use the selected "authorization" component guidance for login/logout cache-clearing and role-based redirects; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
